authority_limit: Builder remediation and validation only; no independent Fresh BREAKER verdict, Owner Acceptance, merge, post-merge authority, hosting-control changes or product/hardware proof.

cross_repository_change.owners: Each canonical repository; shared Manual Verification Bridge boundary
cross_repository_change.boundary: native Windows host selection / path conversion / public verification-gate
cross_repository_change.canonical_schema_change: NONE; fixed closed authority policy and validator unchanged
cross_repository_change.producer_guarantees: Canonical Git objects supply runner/validator; fixed Git-for-Windows installation supplies native Bash; environment fields carry native paths and observed prerequisite results as data.
cross_repository_change.consumer_assumptions: Controlled local Git-for-Windows installation; no adversarial modification of Program Files or OS-admin trust roots. Exact immutable material subjects and explicit base history remain required.
cross_repository_change.sequencing: Validate baseline; BUILDER state-only BUILDING commit; common material fix and per-repository tests; material commit; Builder evidence-only commit; fast-forward push and new CI; new independent Fresh Breaker.
cross_repository_change.rollback: Git history preserves previous material and reports; any authorized future material reversal requires a new digest and validation boundary.
cross_repository_change.fresh_breaker_scope: All six new material subjects, native host/path boundary and dependency failure/cancel/skip behavior.

findings.implementation: Windows PATH fallback removed. Only fixed Git bin Bash then usr/bin Bash can qualify; Windows does not consult shutil.which. Non-Windows PATH semantics retained.
findings.green: Known WSL launcher case/alias variants and arbitrary C:\Tools\bash.exe, MSYS and Cygwin PATH hosts deterministically rejected; fixed-location ordering accepted; no candidate is executed to establish trust.

findings.red: All six old Git workflows had dependency-only execution; non-success could suppress the public gate and no result assertion existed. Permanent workflow regression failed against the old reference.
findings.implementation: Job-level always(); first step before checkout consumes needs.windows-trusted-runner.result via environment, prints it and exits 1 unless exactly 'success'.
findings.regression: Structurally extract job, dependency, unconditional condition, first assertion and actual result data source. Execute actual workflow assertion for every result. Reject conditional or continue-on-error assertions; preserve immutable validator and test steps.

findings.implementation: Native path uses SPAN_GPU_NATIVE_PATH environment data channel with a static quoted Bash cygpath program, explicit UTF-8 decoding, invalid-control rejection and removal of only the output newline. No native path interpolation into shell source.
findings.green: Dedicated apostrophe regression returns exact /c/path\u0027name/runner. Real native files round-trip through Bash unchanged and converted paths read the same object.
findings.injection: Sentinel path remains data; no WTR_SENTINEL side effect. Existing immutable preflight sentinel regressions preserved.
findings.assumption_challenge: A targeted probe found strip() removed trailing whitespace; replaced with removesuffix(newline) and added explicit native trailing-space regression. Win32 filesystem normalization and extended-path namespaces are not claimed as a new universal filesystem contract.

local_validation.red_before_green_reference: New permanent Windows-boundary suite failed on old reference: apostrophe loss, WSL/arbitrary host acceptance, missing gate assertion; old Git-blob probes reproduced all three across all six.
local_validation.authoritative_runner: PASS at material commit with canonical origin/main base; materialized immutable runner/validator blob identities checked.

common_blobs.docs_adaptation: Common helper/order tests integrated with retained native real-host test in all six. docs governance-specific test files preserved; docs total increases from 81 to 97.

prior_guarantees: Full-history and explicit-base validation; immutable runner materialization and validator blob identity; no working-tree Python before preflight; material exclusions/lookalike and import-shadow rejection; closed producer/role/type matrix; merge/post-merge SHA binding; idempotence; existing F001-F007 and docs semantics regressions all pass.

builder_assumption_challenge.host: All Windows PATH candidates, spelling/alias variants and unrelated MSYS/Cygwin are ignored. Fixed installation origin remains an explicit environmental trust assumption.
builder_assumption_challenge.gate: Non-success never permits checkout/validator steps to count as gate validation; unknown values fail. Workflow-wide cancellation or service outage can prevent execution and never supplies success.
builder_assumption_challenge.path: Apostrophes, multiple apostrophes, Unicode and metacharacters are real native tests. No native path is re-stringified into program source. Invalid controls fail; trailing whitespace survives conversion.
builder_assumption_challenge.what_are_we_missing_now: No cryptographic authentication of installed Git, hostile OS administration, live negative GitHub cancellation experiment or product/GPU proof is claimed. Negative dependency semantics are tested with the actual extracted assertion; hosted successful composition is required after push. Independent Fresh Breaker remains required for every new material subject.

post_push_ci: Required on the final Builder Evidence Head: windows-trusted-runner, verification-gate and bootstrap-integrity; .github retains Steward baseline integrity. Pending at report creation; results are a separate hosted observation and never independent authority.

ci_followup.failure: Ubuntu CI simulated os.name=nt without fixed-installation availability; correct host selection raised RuntimeError.
ci_followup.correction: Model fixed-path availability explicitly for both present and absent cases, prohibiting shutil.which in both. No runtime/workflow change or disabled regression.
ci_followup.historical_ci: FAILURE retained; new exact-head hosted validation required.
